# DeMar Transportation — Full Reference

> Nationwide freight transportation and logistics support across the 48 contiguous states. DeMar Transportation serves shippers, brokers, and businesses with dry van, reefer, flatbed, box truck, sprinter van, hazmat, FTL, LTL, 3PL, and warehousing services.

## Company Overview

DeMar Transportation serves freight moving across the 48 contiguous states. The company is headquartered at 10471 Double R Blvd, Reno, NV 89521 and operates with USDOT 4392091, providing motor carrier and freight broker support through its own fleet and vetted carrier network.

Important company facts:

- Headquarters: Reno, Nevada
- Office address: 10471 Double R Blvd, Reno, NV 89521
- Phone: (775) 230-4767
- Email: info@DeMarTransportation.com
- USDOT: 4392091
- Dispatch: 24/7 availability
- Core service area: 48 contiguous states, with Reno/Nevada headquarters support
- Primary website: https://demartransportation.com/
- Sitemap: https://demartransportation.com/sitemap.xml

## Services

### Freight Shipping Services Hub

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/

The services hub organizes DeMar Transportation's freight capabilities into equipment services and logistics solutions. It is the preferred entry point for comparing service types.

### Dry Van Shipping

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/dry-van/

Dry van shipping is used for enclosed, non-temperature-controlled freight such as general merchandise, retail goods, palletized products, boxed freight, and non-perishable cargo. Standard 53-foot dry van trailers commonly handle up to approximately 45,000 pounds and 22 to 26 standard pallets single-stacked.

Related pages:

- [Full Truckload](https://demartransportation.com/services/ftl/)
- [Less Than Truckload](https://demartransportation.com/services/ltl/)
- [Dry Van vs Reefer](https://demartransportation.com/resources/dry-van-vs-reefer/)

### Reefer / Refrigerated Freight

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/reefer/

Reefer freight is temperature-controlled shipping for food, beverage, produce, frozen goods, pharmaceuticals, and other cold chain cargo. Reefer shipments require temperature planning, pre-cooling, appointment timing, and carrier communication.

Related pages:

- [Nevada Reefer Freight](https://demartransportation.com/locations/nevada-reefer-freight/)
- [How to Ship Refrigerated Goods](https://demartransportation.com/resources/how-to-ship-refrigerated-goods/)
- [Refrigerated Freight Shipping Guide](https://demartransportation.com/blog/refrigerated-freight-shipping-guide/)

### Flatbed Shipping

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/flatbed/

Flatbed shipping is open-deck freight for machinery, steel, lumber, construction materials, oversized cargo, and freight that cannot be loaded into an enclosed trailer. Flatbed freight may require tarps, straps, chains, route planning, and oversize permits.

Related pages:

- [Oversized Load Shipping](https://demartransportation.com/resources/oversized-load-shipping/)
- [Types of Freight Trailers](https://demartransportation.com/resources/types-of-freight-trailers/)

### Box Truck Delivery

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/box-truck/

Box truck delivery supports local and regional freight that needs enclosed transport but does not require a full tractor-trailer. It is useful for liftgate needs, limited-access deliveries, local business deliveries, and smaller regional shipments.

### Sprinter Van Shipping

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/sprinter-van/

Sprinter van shipping supports urgent small freight, expedited cargo, dedicated small-vehicle moves, and time-critical shipments that need direct routing.

Related page:

- [Hot Shot vs Full Truckload](https://demartransportation.com/resources/hot-shot-vs-full-truckload/)

### Hazmat Freight

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/hazmat/

Hazmat freight requires DOT-compliant handling, documentation, placarding, carrier qualification, and shipment-specific planning. DeMar Transportation supports shippers moving regulated hazardous materials through qualified capacity.

Related pages:

- [How to Ship Hazardous Materials](https://demartransportation.com/resources/how-to-ship-hazardous-materials/)
- [Hazmat Freight Shipping Requirements](https://demartransportation.com/blog/hazmat-freight-shipping-requirements-cyud/)

### Full Truckload (FTL)

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/ftl/

Full truckload shipping dedicates an entire trailer to one shipper's freight. FTL is typically used for larger shipments, direct point-to-point transit, freight that should avoid terminal handling, or loads that need dedicated equipment.

Related pages:

- [FTL vs LTL](https://demartransportation.com/resources/ftl-vs-ltl/)
- [LTL vs FTL Freight Shipping](https://demartransportation.com/blog/ltl-vs-ftl-freight-shipping/)

### Less Than Truckload (LTL)

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/ltl/

Less-than-truckload freight shares trailer space with other shipments. LTL is useful for palletized freight that is too large for parcel but does not require a dedicated trailer. Pricing depends on freight class, weight, dimensions, distance, and accessorial requirements.

Related pages:

- [Nevada LTL Freight](https://demartransportation.com/locations/nevada-ltl-freight/)
- [LTL Freight Shipping Guide](https://demartransportation.com/blog/ltl-freight-shipping-guide/)
- [Freight Classes Explained](https://demartransportation.com/resources/freight-classes-explained/)

### 3PL Services

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/3pl/

Third-party logistics support includes carrier sourcing, freight management, load coordination, shipment visibility, and logistics planning for businesses that need transportation support without managing every carrier relationship directly.

Related page:

- [Broker vs Carrier vs 3PL](https://demartransportation.com/resources/broker-vs-carrier-vs-3pl/)

### Warehousing and Distribution

URL: https://demartransportation.com/services/warehousing/

Warehousing support includes storage, cross-docking, staging, inventory movement, fulfillment coordination, and outbound distribution planning.

Related pages:

- [Reno Warehouse Distribution](https://demartransportation.com/locations/reno-warehouse-distribution/)
- [Supply Chain Management for Small Business](https://demartransportation.com/blog/supply-chain-management-small-business/)

## Local Freight Pages

### Nevada Freight Locations Hub

URL: https://demartransportation.com/locations/

The locations hub organizes DeMar Transportation's Reno and Nevada local freight pages.

### Reno Freight Shipping

URL: https://demartransportation.com/locations/reno-freight-shipping/

Reno freight shipping support is useful for shippers moving freight through I-80, US-395, California lanes, Pacific Northwest lanes, and Intermountain West routes. The page covers dry van, reefer, flatbed, LTL, FTL, box truck, sprinter van, 3PL, and warehouse-connected freight options from Reno.

### Nevada LTL Freight

URL: https://demartransportation.com/locations/nevada-ltl-freight/

Nevada LTL freight support is for palletized shipments, freight class planning, shared trailer capacity, recurring small business freight, and statewide or nationwide LTL lanes.

### Nevada Reefer Freight

URL: https://demartransportation.com/locations/nevada-reefer-freight/

Nevada reefer freight support is for temperature-controlled freight including food, beverage, produce, frozen goods, pharmaceuticals, and other cold chain shipments.

### Reno Warehouse Distribution

URL: https://demartransportation.com/locations/reno-warehouse-distribution/

Reno warehouse distribution support covers storage, cross-docking, transloading, staging, regional distribution, and freight coordination for shippers using Reno as a Western US distribution point.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What services does DeMar Transportation provide?
A: DeMar Transportation provides dry van, reefer, flatbed, box truck, sprinter van, hazmat, full truckload, less-than-truckload, 3PL, and warehousing support.

Q: Where is DeMar Transportation located?
A: DeMar Transportation is located at 10471 Double R Blvd, Reno, NV 89521.

Q: What is DeMar Transportation's USDOT number?
A: USDOT 4392091.

Q: Does DeMar Transportation serve Nevada shippers?
A: Yes. DeMar Transportation is headquartered in Reno and supports Nevada freight including Reno freight shipping, Nevada LTL, Nevada reefer freight, and Reno warehouse distribution.

Q: How can shippers request a quote?
A: Shippers can request a quote at https://demartransportation.com/quote/ or call (775) 230-4767.

Q: Is dispatch available after hours?
A: Yes. DeMar Transportation provides 24/7 dispatch availability.
